en: Bring stock, soy sauce and sugar to a gentle simmer in a frying pan. Add onion and cook 4 minutes until translucent and soft.
Stir in the chicken and simmer 2 minutes until it soaks up the sauce and the liquid halves.
Beat the eggs lightly, leaving streaks of white. Pour in a circle around the pan; do not stir.
Cover on low for 90 seconds. Stop when the edges are set but the centre still wobbles.
Microwave the rice per pack (2 minutes), fill bowls, slide the chicken and egg with its sauce on top, and scatter spring onion.
zh: 雞高湯、醬油、砂糖倒進平底鍋煮到冒小泡，放洋蔥片煮 4 分鐘，洋蔥變透明軟塌就好。
加入雞肉絲拌開，煮 2 分鐘讓肉吸湯汁，湯量剩約一半。
雞蛋打散但不要打太勻，留一點蛋白條紋。沿鍋邊繞圈倒入，不要攪。
蓋鍋小火 1 分半，蛋液邊緣凝固、中央還會晃動就熄火。
米飯依包裝微波 2 分鐘，盛碗，把鍋裡的雞肉蛋連湯滑到飯上，撒蔥花。

tip.en: Undercook the egg slightly; residual heat finishes it at the table.
tip.zh: 蛋不要煮全熟，端上桌的餘溫會把它燜到剛好。

name.en: Streaky bacon 200 g, cut into 1 cm strips
name.zh: 五花培根 200 g，切 1 cm 段

name.en: Broccoli 1 head, cut into small florets

en: Start the bacon in a cold pan over medium heat and cook 5 minutes until the fat renders and the edges crisp. Remove, keep the fat.
Fry the broccoli in the bacon fat 3 minutes, add 2 tbsp water, cover 2 minutes until bright green and fork-tender.
Microwave the rice 2 minutes and break up the clumps. Pour beaten eggs into the centre; when half set, add the rice and toss on high.
When the grains separate and the pan sizzles, add soy sauce around the edge and toss 1 minute to colour the rice.
Return the bacon, add spring onion and butter, toss twice until the butter melts. Finish with pepper.
zh: 培根下冷鍋中火慢煎 5 分鐘，逼出油、邊緣變脆焦黃，撈起留油。
花椰菜下鍋用培根油炒 3 分鐘，加 2 大匙水蓋鍋悶 2 分鐘，顏色轉鮮綠、叉子能插入就好。
米飯微波 2 分鐘後用手捏散。蛋打散倒進鍋中央，半凝固時把飯倒進去大火翻炒。
飯粒散開、鍋底聽到滋滋聲後淋醬油沿鍋邊下，翻炒 1 分鐘讓飯粒沾上醬色。
放回培根、蔥段、奶油，翻兩下奶油融化即可，撒黑胡椒。

tip.en: Starting bacon in a cold pan renders the fat evenly without toughening it.
tip.zh: 冷鍋下培根，油才逼得乾淨，肉不會硬。

title.en: Crispy Fish Bites Rice Bowl with Tartare
title.zh: 日式炸魚塊丼佐塔塔醬

en: Heat oven to 220°C (air fryer 200°C). Spread fish bites in one layer and cook 15 minutes, turning once, until golden and crisp when pressed.
Mix mayonnaise, lemon juice and half the spring onion for the tartare; it should taste clearly tangy.
Stir soy sauce and sugar until the sugar dissolves for the drizzle.
Microwave the rice 2 minutes. Fill bowls with rice, top with cabbage, then the fish.
Drizzle the soy mix, spoon over the tartare and finish with the remaining spring onion.
zh: 烤箱預熱 220°C（氣炸鍋 200°C）。魚塊單層排開，烤 15 分鐘，中途翻面，外皮金黃、用手按會喀一聲。
美乃滋、檸檬汁、一半蔥花拌成塔塔醬，嚐起來要有明顯酸味。
醬油和砂糖拌到糖溶化，做成淋醬。
米飯微波 2 分鐘。碗底鋪飯，放高麗菜絲，擺魚塊。
淋醬油糖水，擠上塔塔醬，撒剩下的蔥花。

tip.en: Never stack the fish bites; stacked pieces steam instead of crisping.
tip.zh: 魚塊不要疊放，疊了就不脆。

name.zh: 法蘭克福香腸 6 條，斜切

name.en: Streaky bacon 150 g, cut into pieces
Instant noodle packets 2 packets (noodle cakes only)
name.zh: 袋裝即食麵 2 包（麵餅）

en: Loosen gochujang and garlic with 3 tbsp stock in a wide pot, add the rest of the stock and bring to the boil.
Arrange sausages, bacon and sauerkraut in sections and simmer 8 minutes until the bacon turns opaque and the broth goes orange-red.
Add the noodle cakes without pressing them down. Cook 3 minutes until chopsticks can separate the strands, flip, and cook 1 more minute.
Lay cheese slices over the noodles, cover 1 minute until melted into the broth.
Scatter spring onion and bring the pot to the table; keep it simmering while you eat.
zh: 辣醬、蒜末用 3 大匙高湯調開，倒進寬口鍋，加剩下的高湯煮滾。
香腸、培根、酸菜分區擺進鍋裡，中火煮 8 分鐘，培根變不透明、湯色轉橘紅。
放進麵餅，不要壓，煮 3 分鐘，麵條能用筷子撥散就翻面再煮 1 分鐘。
起司片鋪在麵上，蓋鍋 1 分鐘，起司融化流進湯裡。
撒蔥段，整鍋端上桌，邊煮邊吃。

tip.en: Sauerkraut plus gochujang stands in for kimchi: you get both the sour and the heat.
tip.zh: 沒有泡菜就用酸菜加辣醬，酸和辣都到位。

name.en: Broccoli 1 head, cut into small florets

en: Mix gochujang, 1 tbsp sesame oil, soy sauce and sugar into a sauce; stir until no sugar grains remain.
Blanch broccoli 2 minutes until bright green, drain and rinse under cold water.
Toss the chicken with 1 tbsp of the sauce. Salt the carrot lightly, rest 5 minutes and squeeze out the water.
Fry the eggs in 1 tbsp sesame oil until the whites bubble and crisp at the edges while the yolks stay runny.
Microwave rice 2 minutes, bowl it, arrange chicken, broccoli and carrot in sections, top with an egg, spoon over the rest of the sauce and mix at the table.
zh: 辣醬、1 大匙麻油、醬油、砂糖拌成醬，糖要拌到看不見顆粒。
花椰菜放滾水燙 2 分鐘，顏色鮮綠撈起沖冷水瀝乾。
雞肉絲用 1 大匙醬拌勻。紅蘿蔔絲用少許鹽抓 5 分鐘出水擠乾。
平底鍋 1 大匙麻油煎蛋 4 顆，蛋白邊緣起泡變酥、蛋黃仍是液狀就起鍋。
米飯微波 2 分鐘盛碗，雞肉、花椰菜、紅蘿蔔分區放，頂上放煎蛋，淋剩下的醬，拌開吃。

tip.en: Make the sauce first so every bowl seasons evenly when mixed.
tip.zh: 醬先拌好才不會拌飯時鹹的鹹淡的淡。

name.zh: 豬肉鮮蝦水餃 24 顆（約 600 g）
花椰菜 半顆，切小朵

en: Bring the stock and ginger to the boil, add frozen dumplings, return to the boil, then simmer 8 minutes until they all float and the skins turn translucent.
Add broccoli and cook 2 minutes until bright green.
Drizzle beaten egg slowly into the soup while stirring in circles with chopsticks; stop once ribbons form.
Off the heat, add vinegar and sesame oil. Taste and salt.
Ladle into bowls and top with spring onion.
zh: 高湯加薑片煮滾，放冷凍水餃，再次滾起後轉中火煮 8 分鐘，水餃全部浮起、皮變半透明。
加花椰菜煮 2 分鐘，顏色鮮綠。
蛋打散，慢慢淋入湯中，邊淋邊用筷子畫圈，蛋花成絲即停。
熄火，加白醋、麻油，試味加鹽。
分碗，撒蔥花。

tip.en: A splash of vinegar keeps the broth clean and cuts the richness of the dumplings.
tip.zh: 一點白醋讓湯清爽，餃子油膩感全消。

name.en: Streaky bacon 200 g, cut into pieces

en: Start the bacon in a cold pan and cook 5 minutes until crisp. Remove, leaving 1 tbsp fat.
Fry garlic 30 seconds on low until the edges just colour, then add broccoli and toss 2 minutes on high.
Add stock and soy sauce, cover 3 minutes until a chopstick pierces the stems while they keep some bite.
Uncover and boil 1 minute until only a thin glaze remains.
Return the bacon, add sesame oil and pepper, toss twice and serve.
zh: 培根冷鍋中火煎 5 分鐘到酥脆，撈起，鍋裡留 1 大匙油。
蒜片下鍋小火 30 秒，邊緣微黃立刻放花椰菜大火翻炒 2 分鐘。
倒高湯和醬油，蓋鍋悶 3 分鐘，花椰菜梗用筷子能戳穿、還帶脆度。
開蓋大火收汁 1 分鐘，湯汁剩鍋底薄薄一層。
放回培根，淋麻油撒黑胡椒，翻兩下起鍋。

tip.en: Keep the broccoli crisp-tender; soft broccoli loses all its charm.
tip.zh: 花椰菜不要煮軟，帶脆才好吃。

en: Beat the eggs with ½ tsp salt. Heat 2 tbsp oil until it shimmers, pour in the eggs and push with a spatula for 30 seconds until just set and still glossy. Remove.
Add the remaining oil and the tomatoes. Cook 3 minutes over medium heat until they release juice and the pan has a red sauce.
Add sugar and ½ tsp salt and cook 1 minute until the juice thickens slightly.
Return the eggs and toss 30 seconds so they soak up the tomato. Pepper.
Microwave rice 2 minutes, top with the tomato and egg, and scatter spring onion.
zh: 蛋打散加半小匙鹽。鍋燒熱下 2 大匙油，油紋出現時倒蛋，用鏟子推 30 秒，八分熟、還有一點濕就盛起。
同鍋下剩下的油，番茄塊下鍋中火炒 3 分鐘，邊角出汁、鍋底有紅色湯汁。
加砂糖和半小匙鹽，炒 1 分鐘讓湯汁略稠。
蛋倒回鍋，翻炒 30 秒讓蛋吸滿番茄汁，撒黑胡椒。
米飯微波 2 分鐘，番茄蛋鋪上去，撒蔥花。

tip.en: Take the eggs out early; they finish cooking when they go back in.
tip.zh: 蛋要提早盛起，回鍋才不會老。

en: Simmer 100 ml of the coconut milk 2 minutes until the oil separates and the surface looks glossy.
Add curry paste and fry 1 minute until fragrant and deep red.
Add the rest of the coconut milk, fish sauce and sugar, bring to the boil, add broccoli and cook 4 minutes until the stems soften.
Stir in the chicken and heat 2 minutes. Off the heat, add lime juice.
Microwave rice 2 minutes and spoon the curry over.
zh: 椰奶先倒 100 ml 進鍋中火煮 2 分鐘，油浮起、表面出現亮亮油紋。
加咖哩醬炒 1 分鐘到香味明顯、顏色變深紅。
倒入剩下的椰奶、魚露、砂糖煮滾，放花椰菜煮 4 分鐘到梗變軟。
加雞肉絲煮 2 分鐘讓肉熱透，熄火加萊姆汁。
米飯微波 2 分鐘，咖哩淋上。

tip.en: Splitting the coconut milk before adding the paste makes the curry far more fragrant.
tip.zh: 椰奶先煮出油再下咖哩醬，香氣差很多。

en: Warm peanut butter, coconut milk, soy sauce, garlic and chilli in a small pot over low heat, stirring 4 minutes until smooth and thick enough to coat a spoon.
Add the chicken and heat 2 minutes; the sauce thickens a little more.
Off the heat, add lime juice; loosen with 2 tbsp water if too thick.
Microwave the rice 2 minutes.
Serve the satay chicken on rice with cucumber on the side.
zh: 花生醬、椰奶、醬油、蒜末、辣椒粉放小鍋，小火邊煮邊攪 4 分鐘，醬變滑順、湯匙拉起會掛住。
加雞肉絲拌勻煮 2 分鐘讓肉熱透，醬會再稠一點。
熄火加萊姆汁，太稠加 2 大匙水調整。
米飯微波 2 分鐘。
飯上放沙嗲雞，旁邊放小黃瓜片解膩。

tip.en: Too thick? Add water. Too thin? Simmer another minute.
tip.zh: 醬太稠就加水，太稀多煮一分鐘。

name.en: Streaky bacon 200 g, cut into 1 cm pieces

name.zh: 放養雞蛋 3 顆 + 2 顆蛋黃

en: Boil a large pot of water with 1 tbsp salt and cook the spaghetti 1 minute less than the pack says. Save 1 cup of pasta water.
Start bacon and garlic in a cold pan over medium heat and cook 6 minutes until crisp and golden. Discard the garlic.
Whisk eggs, yolks, cheese and 1 tsp pepper in a large bowl.
Take the pan off the heat for 30 seconds, toss the pasta in the bacon fat, then tip everything into the egg bowl and stir fast.
Add pasta water 2 tbsp at a time until the sauce is glossy and coats every strand with no watery pools and no scrambled bits. Finish with pepper.
zh: 大鍋水加 1 大匙鹽煮滾，下麵煮包裝時間少 1 分鐘，撈起前留 1 杯煮麵水。
培根和蒜下冷鍋中火煎 6 分鐘，培根金黃酥脆，撈掉蒜。
蛋、蛋黃、起司、1 小匙黑胡椒在大碗裡打勻。
鍋離火 30 秒稍降溫，麵倒進培根鍋拌一下，再全部倒進蛋液碗裡快速攪拌。
分次加煮麵水，每次 2 大匙，攪到醬變成能裹住每根麵的奶油狀，不見水汪汪也沒有蛋塊。撒黑胡椒上桌。

tip.en: Always mix the egg off the heat; a hot pan gives you scrambled egg.
tip.zh: 鍋一定要離火再拌蛋，太燙會變炒蛋。

name.en: Sliced ham 200 g, cut into strips

en: Heat oven to 200°C. Cook the penne 2 minutes short of the pack time, adding broccoli for the last 2 minutes. Drain together.
Mix pasta, broccoli, sauce, sour cream, ham, herbs and half the cheese until every piece is coated.
Spread in a baking dish and cover with the remaining cheese.
Bake 20 minutes until the cheese bubbles and the edges brown.
Rest 5 minutes before serving. Finish with pepper.
zh: 烤箱預熱 200°C。麵煮到包裝時間少 2 分鐘，最後 2 分鐘把花椰菜丟進同一鍋，一起瀝乾。
麵、花椰菜、麵醬、酸奶油、火腿、香草、一半起司拌勻，每根麵都要沾到醬。
倒進烤盤鋪平，剩下的起司鋪滿表面。
烤 20 分鐘，起司融化冒泡、邊緣焦黃。
出爐靜置 5 分鐘再切，撒黑胡椒。

tip.en: Undercook the pasta by 2 minutes so it stays firm after baking.
tip.zh: 麵少煮 2 分鐘，進烤箱才不會糊。

title.zh: 英式瑪芬火腿蛋早午餐

en: Split the muffins and toast cut side up 3 minutes until the edges are golden.
Fry the ham 1 minute per side over medium heat until the edges curl. Remove.
Melt butter in the same pan; when it foams, crack in the eggs and fry 3 minutes until the whites are set and the yolks still wobble.
Spread aioli on the bottom halves, stack ham, cheese, tomato and an egg.
Pepper, close with the tops and eat hot.
zh: 瑪芬對半剖開，切面朝上烤 3 分鐘，邊緣金黃。
平底鍋中火，火腿每面煎 1 分鐘，邊緣微捲，起鍋。
同鍋放奶油，融化起泡後打入蛋，煎 3 分鐘，蛋白全白、蛋黃還會晃就好。
瑪芬下半片抹蒜味美乃滋，疊火腿、起司片、番茄、煎蛋。
撒黑胡椒，蓋上上半片，趁熱吃。

tip.en: Put the cheese on the hot ham and it melts on its own.
tip.zh: 起司放在熱火腿上，餘溫就會融。

en: Fry the chorizo 4 minutes over medium heat until the oil runs red and the edges crisp. Set half aside.
Cook onion and garlic in the chorizo oil 4 minutes until translucent.
Add pasta sauce and herbs and simmer 5 minutes until thick enough that a spoon leaves a trail.
Make 6 wells, crack an egg into each, cover and cook on low 6 minutes until the whites set and the yolks stay soft.
Top with the reserved chorizo and pepper. Warm the naan and serve with sour cream for dipping.
zh: 臘腸片下平底鍋中火煎 4 分鐘，出紅油、邊緣微焦，撈起一半備用。
洋蔥丁、蒜末下鍋用臘腸油炒 4 分鐘到洋蔥透明。
倒麵醬和香草，小火煮 5 分鐘到醬變稠、勺子劃過能看到鍋底。
用湯匙在醬裡挖 6 個洞，各打一顆蛋，蓋鍋小火 6 分鐘，蛋白凝固、蛋黃半熟。
撒回臘腸片和黑胡椒，烤餅烤熱，配酸奶油沾著吃。

tip.en: Want firmer yolks? Give it one more minute under the lid.
tip.zh: 蛋黃想更熟就多蓋 1 分鐘。

en: Air fry the fish at 200°C in one layer for 10 minutes, turning once, until golden and crisp to the touch.
Mix aioli with lemon juice; toss the cabbage with half of it for a quick slaw.
Split the muffins and warm them in the air fryer for the last 2 minutes.
Spread the remaining aioli on the bottoms, add cheese, the hot fish and the slaw.
Pepper and close with the tops.
zh: 氣炸鍋 200°C，魚排單層放，氣炸 10 分鐘，中途翻面，表面金黃、按下去酥脆。
蒜味美乃滋和檸檬汁拌勻，高麗菜絲用一半的醬拌成沙拉。
瑪芬對半剖開，氣炸最後 2 分鐘放進去烤熱。
下半片抹剩下的醬，放起司片、熱魚排、高麗菜沙拉。
撒黑胡椒，蓋上上半片。

tip.en: Cheese under the hot fillet melts without any extra step.
tip.zh: 起司壓在熱魚排下面就會融化。

title.zh: 微波奶油雞咖哩配烤餅

name.en: Butter chicken recipe base 1 jar (about 500 g)
name.zh: 奶油雞料理包 1 包（約 500 g）
花椰菜 半顆，切小朵

en: Microwave the broccoli with 2 tbsp water, covered, 3 minutes until bright green.
Mix chicken and the sauce in a large bowl, cover and microwave 5 minutes, stirring once, until bubbling and piping hot.
Stir in the broccoli and half the yoghurt; microwave 1 more minute.
Microwave rice 2 minutes; sprinkle the naan with water and microwave 40 seconds until soft and warm.
Serve the curry with rice and naan, topped with the remaining yoghurt.
zh: 花椰菜放可微波碗加 2 大匙水，蓋上微波 3 分鐘，顏色鮮綠。
雞肉絲和料理包醬倒進大碗拌勻，蓋上微波 5 分鐘，中途攪一次，醬冒泡、雞肉燙手。
拌入花椰菜和一半優格，再微波 1 分鐘。
米飯微波 2 分鐘；烤餅噴一點水，微波 40 秒變軟熱。
咖哩配飯和烤餅，頂上放剩下的優格。

tip.en: Add the yoghurt at the end so it keeps its tang.
tip.zh: 優格最後放，酸味才留得住。

en: Toss the wedges with BBQ rub and air fry at 200°C for 12 minutes, shaking once, until the edges are golden and crisp.
Push the wedges aside, add nuggets and cook 8 more minutes, turning once, until golden outside and white all the way through.
Mix sour cream with spring onion for a dip.
Plate wedges and nuggets with BBQ sauce, the sour cream dip and cucumber sticks.
Eat hot.
zh: 薯角撒燒烤香料粉拌勻，氣炸鍋 200°C 先炸 12 分鐘，中途搖一次，邊緣金黃酥脆。
薯角推到一邊，雞塊放進去再炸 8 分鐘，翻面一次，雞塊表面金黃、剝開裡面全白。
酸奶油拌蔥花做沾醬。
薯角和雞塊擺盤，燒烤醬、蔥花酸奶油、小黃瓜條放旁邊。
趁熱吃。

tip.en: Start the wedges first so both finish at the same time.
tip.zh: 薯角先炸再放雞塊，兩樣才會同時剛好。

en: Stir cinnamon and 2 tbsp honey into the yoghurt until evenly pale brown with no white streaks.
Put a layer of granola (about 2 tbsp) in each of 4 glasses.
Spoon in half the yoghurt, add banana slices, then the rest of the yoghurt.
Top with the remaining granola and the cranberries.
Drizzle ½ tbsp honey over each just before eating.
zh: 優格加肉桂粉和 2 大匙蜂蜜拌勻，顏色變淡棕、看不到白色條紋。
4 個杯子各鋪一層麥片（約 2 大匙）。
舀一半的優格進杯，放香蕉片，再蓋上剩下的優格。
頂上放剩下的麥片和蔓越莓乾。
吃之前各淋半大匙蜂蜜。

tip.en: Add the granola right before eating so it stays crunchy.
tip.zh: 麥片吃之前才放才會脆。

title.en: No-bake Peanut Butter Cookie Ice Cream Cups
title.zh: 免烤花生醬餅乾冰淇淋杯

name.zh: 巧克力豆餅乾 4 片，捏碎

en: Crush the biscuits in a bag with a rolling pin to coarse crumbs, then mix in the melted butter until it holds together when squeezed.
Press the crumbs into 4 cups and freeze 5 minutes to set.
Microwave the peanut butter 20 seconds until it flows.
Scoop ice cream into the cups and drizzle 1 tbsp peanut butter over each.
Top with crumbled cookies and the remaining peanut butter. Eat straight away.
zh: 夾心餅放袋子裡用擀麵棍敲碎成粗砂狀，倒入融化的奶油拌到捏得成團。
餅乾屑分進 4 個杯子壓實，冷凍 5 分鐘定型。
花生醬微波 20 秒變流動狀。
冰淇淋挖進杯子，每杯淋 1 大匙花生醬。
撒碎巧克力豆餅乾，剩下的花生醬淋在最上面，馬上吃。

tip.en: A quick zap makes the peanut butter pourable.
tip.zh: 花生醬微波一下才淋得開。

title.en: Clear Beef Soup with Daikon & Carrot

name.en: Stewing beef 1.2 kg (chuck, casserole steak or brisket), cut into 4 cm chunks
name.zh: 燉煮用牛肉 1.2 kg（肩胛、燉肉塊或牛腩），切 4 cm 塊

name.en: Daikon radish 600 g (or parsnips), peeled, cut into 3 cm chunks
name.zh: 白蘿蔔 600 g（買不到可用歐防風），去皮切 3 cm 塊

name.en: Carrots 2 (about 300 g), peeled, cut into 3 cm chunks
name.zh: 紅蘿蔔 2 根（約 300 g），去皮切 3 cm 塊

name.en: Rice cooking wine 2 tbsp (or Shaoxing wine)
name.zh: 米酒 2 大匙（或紹興酒）

en: Put the beef in a pot, cover with cold water and bring to the boil over high heat. Boil 3 minutes, until grey scum rises and the outside of the meat is no longer red. Drain, rinse the beef under warm water and wash the pot.

Return the beef to the pot with 2.5 litres of fresh water, the ginger and the onion. Bring to the boil and skim until the surface is clear, then turn to low, set the lid ajar and simmer 1 hour — the surface should just shiver with small bubbles, never boil hard.

Add the daikon and carrot and simmer another 40 minutes, until a chopstick slides easily into the beef and the daikon turns translucent (if using parsnips, add them after 20 minutes so they don't fall apart). Lift out the ginger.
Season at the end: stir in the rice wine and 2 tsp salt and simmer 3 minutes to cook off the alcohol. Taste, and add salt a pinch at a time until the broth tastes rich but not salty.
Ladle into bowls with 3–4 pieces of beef and some radish each, scatter spring onion while hot, and serve with rice.
zh: 牛肉塊放進湯鍋，加冷水蓋過，大火煮滾後再滾 3 分鐘，水面浮起一層灰色浮沫、肉的表面不再是紅色就好。倒掉水，牛肉用溫水沖乾淨，鍋子也洗乾淨。
牛肉放回鍋裡，加 2.5 公升清水、薑片和洋蔥，大火煮滾後撈掉浮沫到湯面清澈，轉小火、鍋蓋留一條縫燉 1 小時，湯面只微微冒小泡、不要大滾。
放入白蘿蔔和紅蘿蔔再燉 40 分鐘，筷子能輕鬆戳穿牛肉、白蘿蔔變半透明就好（用歐防風的話等 20 分鐘後再放，太早放會煮散）。夾掉薑片。
最後才調味：倒入米酒和 2 小匙鹽，再煮 3 分鐘讓酒氣散掉。喝一口湯，淡的話一次加一小撮鹽，喝起來鮮、不死鹹就好。
盛碗，每碗放 3–4 塊牛肉和幾塊蘿蔔，趁熱撒上蔥花，配白飯吃。

tip.en: Blanching first and keeping it at a bare simmer is what keeps the broth clear rather than cloudy.
tip.zh: 先汆燙把血水和浮沫去掉、燉的時候保持小滾，湯才會清澈不混濁。

6.en: Lift out 60 g beef (1–2 pieces, fat and sinew trimmed off), 2 pieces each of carrot and daikon, and 4 tbsp of the unseasoned broth. Blend with a blender or stick blender until completely smooth, like thick yoghurt with no lumps; add a little more broth if it's too thick. Cool to lukewarm before feeding. Freeze any extra in an ice-cube tray and use within a month.
6.zh: 撈出牛肉 60 g（約 1–2 塊，挑掉肥肉和筋）、紅蘿蔔和白蘿蔔各 2 塊，加 4 大匙還沒調味的原湯，用果汁機或手持攪拌棒打成完全滑順的泥，稠度像濃優格、看不到顆粒；太稠就再加一點原湯。放涼到微溫再餵。一次吃不完的倒進製冰盒分格冷凍，一個月內吃完。

9.en: Lift out 30 g beef (about half a piece, fat and sinew trimmed off) and 1 piece each of carrot and daikon. Finely chop the beef into bits about 0.5 cm and mash the vegetables with a fork into a lumpy mash, then stir in 1–2 tbsp of the unseasoned broth so it's moist and soft enough to squash with gums. Cool to lukewarm before feeding.
9.zh: 撈出牛肉 30 g（約半塊，挑掉肥肉和筋）、紅蘿蔔和白蘿蔔各 1 塊。牛肉剁成約 0.5 cm 的碎丁，蘿蔔用叉子壓成帶小顆粒的粗泥，拌入 1–2 大匙還沒調味的原湯，濕潤、軟到用牙齦就壓得碎。放涼到微溫再餵。

12.en: Lift out 50 g beef (about 1 piece), 2 pieces each of carrot and daikon, and a small bowl of the unseasoned broth. Cut the beef across the grain into about 1 cm pieces (short fibres are easier to chew and less of a choking risk) and the vegetables into 1 cm cubes, for baby to pick up by hand or eat with a spoon, with the broth to sip. Cool to lukewarm before serving.
12.zh: 撈出牛肉 50 g（約 1 塊）、紅蘿蔔和白蘿蔔各 2 塊，舀小半碗還沒調味的原湯。牛肉逆著紋路切成約 1 cm 小塊（纖維切短比較好嚼、不容易噎到），蘿蔔也切 1 cm 塊，讓寶寶用手抓或用湯匙自己吃，湯配著喝。放涼到微溫再給。

variations.en: Day 1: as it is — a big bowl of beef, radish, carrot and broth, with rice.
variations.zh: 第 1 天：原味清燉，大碗盛牛肉、蘿蔔和湯，配白飯。

variations.en: Day 2: beef noodle soup — pour the boiling soup over cooked noodles and add a handful of blanched greens.
variations.zh: 第 2 天：清燉牛肉麵，麵條煮好放碗裡，淋上煮滾的湯，加一把燙青菜。

variations.en: Day 3: tomato beef soup — add 2 chopped tomatoes and 1 diced potato and simmer 20 minutes until the potato is soft.
variations.zh: 第 3 天：番茄牛肉湯，加 2 顆番茄切塊、1 顆馬鈴薯切丁，再煮 20 分鐘到馬鈴薯軟爛。

storage.en: Cool, then refrigerate covered within 2 hours. Keep day 2's share in the fridge; freeze day 3's share straight away (keeps a month) and move it to the fridge the night before. Always bring to a rolling boil before eating.
storage.zh: 放涼後 2 小時內加蓋冷藏。第 2 天的份放冷藏；第 3 天的份當天就分裝冷凍（可放一個月），前一晚移到冷藏退冰。每次吃之前都要煮到大滾。

name.en: Plain unsweetened yoghurt 3 tbsp (for baby, instead of cream)
name.zh: 原味無糖優格 3 大匙（寶寶份不用鮮奶油時）

en: Heat the oven to 150°C (fan off). Draw a 20 cm circle on baking paper, turn it over and lay it on an oven tray.
Separate the eggs, putting the whites in a large, clean, dry bowl with no trace of yolk. Beat on medium for about 2 minutes, until soft peaks form — the tips curl over when you lift the beaters.

Turn to high and add the 220 g caster sugar a spoonful at a time over about 5 minutes. Keep beating until the meringue is thick and glossy, stands in stiff peaks, and feels smooth rather than gritty when rubbed between your fingers.
Sprinkle over 2 tsp cornflour, 1 tsp vinegar and the vanilla and beat 10 seconds, just until mixed. Pile onto the circle and spread to the edge, leaving the sides a little higher than the middle.

Put it in the oven and immediately turn down to 120°C. Bake 1 hour 15 minutes, until the outside is dry and crisp and the whole pavlova slides on the paper. Turn the oven off and leave it inside with the door ajar until completely cool, at least 1 hour.
Whip the cream on medium until soft peaks form — it holds a soft curl on the whisk but still looks silky.
Add the 1 tbsp caster sugar and beat 10 seconds more, just until combined; over-beaten cream turns grainy and weeps.

Peel and slice the kiwifruit and halve any strawberries (blueberries go on whole). Just before serving, spread the cream over the pavlova and pile on the fruit. Eat within an hour, before the base softens.
zh: 烤箱預熱到 150°C（不開旋風）。在烘焙紙上畫一個直徑 20 cm 的圓，翻面鋪在烤盤上。
蛋白和蛋黃分開，蛋白放進乾淨、沒有水也沒有油的大碗，不能混到蛋黃。電動打蛋器中速打約 2 分鐘，提起來尖端會彎下來（濕性發泡）就好。
轉高速，220 g 細砂糖一次一匙、分約 5 分鐘加完。繼續打到蛋白霜濃稠發亮、提起來尖端挺立不垂，用手指搓一點不再有沙沙的顆粒感。
撒入 2 小匙玉米粉、1 小匙白醋和香草精，打 10 秒剛好混勻就停。倒在畫好的圓裡抹到邊緣，四周稍微堆高、中間微微凹。
放進烤箱後立刻調到 120°C，烤 1 小時 15 分鐘，表面乾爽酥脆、能整個在紙上推動就好。關掉烤箱、門開一條縫，讓它在裡面放到完全涼，至少 1 小時。
鮮奶油用中速打到濕性發泡：提起打蛋器會掛著軟軟的彎勾，表面還是光滑的。
加入 1 大匙細砂糖再打 10 秒拌勻就停，打過頭會變粗糙出水。
奇異果去皮切片，草莓對切（藍莓整顆放）。上桌前才把鮮奶油抹在蛋白霜上、鋪滿水果，1 小時內吃完，放久底部會變軟。

tip.en: Even a trace of yolk or grease stops whites whipping — wipe the bowl and beaters with a little vinegar on a paper towel first.
tip.zh: 蛋白碰到一點蛋黃或油就打不發，打之前先用廚房紙沾一點白醋把碗和攪拌頭擦過。

12.en: As soon as the cream reaches soft peaks, before anything else goes in, spoon 3 tbsp into baby's bowl (or use 3 tbsp plain yoghurt whose label lists only milk and cultures). Peel the kiwifruit and cut it into 1 cm dice, quarter each blueberry and dice the strawberries, then spoon them over the cream for baby to eat with a spoon. If it's baby's first kiwifruit, start with a small taste and watch for redness around the mouth. The meringue is for the grown-ups only.
12.zh: 鮮奶油打到濕性發泡、還沒調味之前，先舀 3 大匙到寶寶碗（或改用 3 大匙原味優格，選成分只有牛奶和菌種的）。奇異果去皮切 1 cm 小丁，藍莓每顆切成四等分，草莓切小丁，放在鮮奶油上給寶寶用湯匙吃。第一次吃奇異果先給一小口，看嘴邊有沒有發紅。蛋白霜只給大人，不給寶寶。
